<ray-button> · RayButton

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
variantvariant reflectsfilled | light | outline | subtle | default | transparent | gradient | raisedfilledVisual style. raised: a physical key on a darker edge that sinks when pressed (mouse, touch or keyboard).
gradientgradient reflectsstringWith variant=gradient: "from to [deg]", palette colors or CSS colors ("teal blue 90"). Default: the --ray-gradient-* tokens.
colorcolorstringA palette color (blue, red…) or any CSS color. Default: the primary color.
sizesize reflectsxs | sm | md | lg | xlsmHeight, padding and font size.
radiusradiusxs | sm | md | lg | xl | fullCorner radius. Default: --ray-radius-default.
typetypebutton | submit | resetbuttonsubmit/reset act on the enclosing form.
disableddisabledbooleanNot interactive (also when inside a disabled fieldset).
loadingloadingbooleanShows a spinner over the content and blocks clicks.
fullWidthfull-widthbooleanTakes the whole width of its container.
hrefhrefstringRenders a link instead of a button.
targettargetstringLink target, with href.
namenamestringWith type=submit: submitted as name=value.
valuevaluestringWith type=submit: the submitted value.
SlotDescription
(default)The label.
leftIcon or content before the label.
rightIcon or content after the label.
PartDescription
buttonThe inner <button> or <a>.
labelThe label wrapper.

Button group

Buttons joined into one control: inner corners squared, borders overlapped. Works with ray-button, ray-icon-button, menus with a button trigger and fields (ray-input, ray-select, ray-search).

Left Center Right Deploy Deploy to staging Schedule… 100%
Search Top Middle Bottom
HTML
<div class="demo-row">
  <ray-button-group label="Text alignment">
    <ray-button variant="default">Left</ray-button>
    <ray-button variant="default">Center</ray-button>
    <ray-button variant="default">Right</ray-button>
  </ray-button-group>
  <ray-button-group label="Deploy">
    <ray-button>Deploy</ray-button>
    <ray-menu placement="bottom-end">
      <ray-icon-button slot="trigger" variant="filled" label="More deploy options"><ray-icon name="chevron-down"></ray-icon></ray-icon-button>
      <ray-menu-item value="staging">Deploy to staging</ray-menu-item>
      <ray-menu-item value="schedule">Schedule…</ray-menu-item>
    </ray-menu>
  </ray-button-group>
  <ray-button-group label="Zoom">
    <ray-icon-button variant="default" label="Zoom out"><ray-icon name="minus"></ray-icon></ray-icon-button>
    <ray-button variant="default">100%</ray-button>
    <ray-icon-button variant="default" label="Zoom in"><ray-icon name="plus"></ray-icon></ray-icon-button>
  </ray-button-group>
</div>

    <ray-button variant="default">Search</ray-button>

    <ray-button variant="default">Top</ray-button>
    <ray-button variant="default">Middle</ray-button>
    <ray-button variant="default">Bottom</ray-button>
  </ray-button-group>
</div>

Toggle

A two-state button (aria-pressed): bold in a toolbar, mute, favorite. The variant is how "on" looks; "off" is always neutral, so the states differ by more than color. Has everything ray-button has and joins a ray-button-group.

Variants · off and on
offonon · teal subtle (default)FavoriteFavoriteFavorite outlineWrap linesWrap linesWrap lines lightMuteMuteMute filledLiveLiveLive raisedPowerPowerPower

Click any of them. Off is always neutral, so on differs by more than color. ray-button's default, transparent and gradient are not toggle variants.

Icon toggles

For toolbars where toggles share one value (bold / italic, alignment), see ray-toggle-group.

Sizes and states
xs sm md lg Disabled on Disabled off

Flip a toggle to see its ray-change event.

<script type="module">
  const out = document.getElementById("demo-toggle-out");
  out.closest(".example").addEventListener("ray-change", (e) => {
    if (e.target.localName !== "ray-toggle") return;
    const name = e.target.label || e.target.textContent.trim();
    out.textContent = `ray-change: ${name} → pressed = ${e.detail.pressed}`;
  });
</script>

<ray-toggle> · RayToggle

Click, Enter or Space flips pressed and fires ray-change. In a form it is submitted like a checkbox: value (default "on") under name while pressed; reset restores the initial pressed attribute.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
pressedpressed reflectsbooleanOn.
variantvariant reflectssubtle | outline | light | filled | raisedsubtleLook of "on": subtle (tint), outline (colored border + tint), light (muted → tint), filled (surface → solid color), raised (a key that latches down, lit). ray-button's default, transparent and gradient are left out: no distinct on state, or only a color change.
squaresquare reflectsbooleanSquare, for an icon alone (give it a label).
labellabel reflectsstringAccessible name and tooltip, for icon-only toggles.
EventDescription
ray-changeThe user flipped it (also a plain change event).
changeThe user flipped it.
SlotDescription
(default)Text or an icon.

Toggle group

ray-toggle elements with one shared value: type="single" (at most one on: alignment, view mode) or "multiple" (bold / italic / underline). Joined like a button group, or spaced; arrow keys move between toggles; submitted with its form.

Single · one choice, can be cleared
Day Week Month

The second one is required: the selected toggle cannot be turned off.

Multiple · any number
B I U S M T W T F S S
Raised · a row of latching keys
Slow Normal Fast

Change a group to see its ray-change event.

    <ray-toggle value="right" label="Align right"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6h16M10 12h10M6 18h14"/></svg></ray-toggle>
  </ray-toggle-group>
  <ray-toggle-group type="single" value="week" label="Range" required spaced variant="light">

<p id="demo-tg-out" class="demo-muted" style="margin: 0">Change a group to see its ray-change event.</p>
<script type="module">
  const out = document.getElementById("demo-tg-out");
  out.closest(".example").addEventListener("ray-change", (e) => {
    if (e.target.localName !== "ray-toggle-group") return;

<ray-toggle-group> · RayToggleGroup

Each toggle's value (else its text) is its key. variant, color, size, radius and square reach the toggles that do not set their own. One tab stop (the selected toggle); arrows, Home and End move; Space/Enter flips.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
typetype reflectssingle | multiplesinglesingle: choosing one turns the others off; multiple: each toggle is independent.
valuevaluestringThe selected key (single) or keys (multiple: an array, or a comma-separated attribute).
namename reflectsstringForm field name: the value (multiple: one entry per key).
requiredrequired reflectsbooleanNeeds a value; with single the selected toggle cannot be turned off.
disableddisabled reflectsbooleanDisables every toggle.
spacedspaced reflectsbooleanToggles apart, each with its own corners (default: joined).
variantvariant reflectssubtle | outline | light | filled | raisedVariant of the toggles.
colorcolor reflectsstringColor of the toggles' on state.
sizesize reflectsxs | sm | md | lg | xlSize of the toggles.
radiusradius reflectsstringCorner radius of the toggles.
squaresquare reflectsbooleanSquare toggles, for icons.
EventDescription
ray-changeThe user changed the selection (the toggles' own events stop at the group). Also a plain change event.
changeThe user changed the selection.
SlotDescription
(default)ray-toggle elements.

Checkbox

A checkbox with label, description and error. Submits value when checked.

Send me updates (label as content)

File upload

A drop zone to pick files: drag, click, keyboard or paste. Checks type, size and count as files arrive, lists them as ray-attachment rows (thumbnails, remove) and submits them with its form.

HTML
<div class="demo-grid">
  <ray-file-upload label="Release assets" name="assets" multiple max-files="5" max-size="10 MB"
    accept=".zip,.dmg,.json,image/*" description="Bundles, the update manifest and screenshots."></ray-file-upload>
  <div class="demo-stack">
    <ray-file-upload label="Avatar" name="avatar" accept="image/png,image/jpeg" max-size="2 MB" variant="compact"
      drop-label="Drop an image" list="cards"></ray-file-upload>
    <ray-file-upload label="Signing key" accept=".pem" variant="compact" drop-label="Drop the .pem file" color="teal"></ray-file-upload>
    <ray-file-upload label="Locked" variant="compact" disabled hint="Uploads are paused during the release"></ray-file-upload>
  </div>
</div>
<ray-file-upload id="demo-upload" label="Simulated upload" multiple list="rows"
  hint="Files are not sent anywhere: the progress is simulated"></ray-file-upload>
<script type="module">
  const up = document.getElementById("demo-upload");
  up.addEventListener("ray-change", (e) => {
    for (const file of e.detail.added) {
      let pct = 0;
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        const row = up.attachmentFor(file);
        if (!row) return clearInterval(timer);
        pct = Math.min(100, pct + 8 + Math.random() * 18);
        row.progress = Math.round(pct);
        if (pct >= 100) {
          clearInterval(timer);
          row.progress = undefined;
          if (/fail/i.test(file.name)) { row.status = "error"; row.error = "Server rejected the file"; }
        }
      }, 300);
    }
  });
</script>

<ray-file-upload> · RayFileUpload

A drag that can only be refused turns the zone red before the drop; refused files fire ray-reject and are explained under the zone. Without multiple a new file replaces the current one. Uploading is the app's: attachmentFor(file) gives the row whose progress/status/error to set.

Sidebar

The side navigation of an app shell: header, content and footer; on wide screens it collapses to an icon rail, below a breakpoint it becomes an off-canvas drawer. toggle() does the right thing for the screen.

ray-remote

<ray-sidebar>

widthwidthstringWidth when expanded (CSS length). Default 16rem.
collapsedWidthcollapsed-widthstringWidth of the icon rail. Default 3.5rem.

  palette.actions = [
    { id: "new", label: "New file", group: "File", icon: "file", shortcut: "⌘ N", onSelect: () => say("New file") },
    { id: "open", label: "Open file…", group: "File", icon: "folder", shortcut: "⌘ O", keywords: ["load"], onSelect: () => say("Open file") },
    { id: "save", label: "Save", group: "File", icon: "check", shortcut: "⌘ S", disabled: true },
    { id: "run", label: "Run program", description: "ray run src/main.ray", group: "Raylang", icon: "play", onSelect: () => say("ray run") },
    { id: "test", label: "Run tests", description: "ray test", group: "Raylang", icon: "circle-check", onSelect: () => say("ray test") },
    { id: "fmt", label: "Format document", description: "ray fmt", group: "Raylang", icon: "terminal", keywords: ["prettier", "style"], onSelect: () => say("ray fmt") },
    { id: "theme", label: "Toggle theme", group: "View", icon: "moon", onSelect: () => say("Theme") },
  ];
  document.getElementById("demo-palette-open").addEventListener("click", () => palette.show());
</script>

<div style="margin-top: 1rem; display: grid; gap: 0.75rem">
  <ray-file-upload id="demo-attach-input" label="Add files" variant="compact" multiple list="none"
    drop-label="Drop files to attach"></ray-file-upload>
  <ray-attachments id="demo-attach-list"></ray-attachments>
</div>
<script type="module">
  // The upload only picks files; this list shows them (list="none" hides its own).
  const list = document.getElementById("demo-attach-list");
  const upload = document.getElementById("demo-attach-input");
  upload.addEventListener("ray-change", (e) => {
    for (const f of e.detail.added) {
      const a = document.createElement("ray-attachment");
      a.removable = true;
      a.file = f;
      list.append(a);
    }
    upload.files = [];
  });
</script>

    "chevron-down": solid("M7 9h10l-5 6z"),

</script>

Table

A data table from columns and data: sorting (aria-sort), row selection, clickable rows, sticky header, striped, empty state. Plain HTML tables: the .ray-table class of base.css.

Click a row, sort a column, or select rows.

Deploy a release to see it here.

HTML
<ray-table id="demo-table" selectable clickable-rows striped with-border sticky-header label="Releases" style="--ray-table-max-height: 16rem"></ray-table>
<p id="demo-table-out" style="margin: 0; font-size: var(--ray-font-size-sm); color: var(--ray-muted-foreground)">Click a row, sort a column, or select rows.</p>
<ray-table id="demo-table-empty" label="Deployments" with-border>
  <ray-empty-state slot="empty" label="No deployments" compact>Deploy a release to see it here.</ray-empty-state>
</ray-table>
<table class="ray-table ray-table-bordered">
  <thead><tr><th>Plain HTML</th><th>class="ray-table"</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><td>Server-rendered</td><td>No JavaScript</td></tr><tr><td>rayauth</td><td>Users list</td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<script type="module">
  const t = document.getElementById("demo-table");
  const out = document.getElementById("demo-table-out");
  t.columns = [
    { key: "app", label: "App", sortable: true },
    { key: "version", label: "Version", sortable: true },
    { key: "size", label: "Size", align: "right", sortable: true, render: (r) => `${r.size.toFixed(1)} MB` },
    { key: "status", label: "Status", render: (r) => {
      const b = document.createElement("ray-badge");
      b.color = r.status === "live" ? "green" : r.status === "failed" ? "red" : "gray";
      b.textContent = r.status;
      return b;
    } },
  ];
  t.data = [
    { id: 1, app: "ray-remote", version: "0.4.1", size: 8.4, status: "live" },
    { id: 2, app: "ray-sublime", version: "1.9.0", size: 21.7, status: "live" },
    { id: 3, app: "rayauth", version: "0.10.2", size: 6.1, status: "failed" },
    { id: 4, app: "raymart", version: "0.3.0", size: 12.9, status: "draft" },
    { id: 5, app: "ray808", version: "2.0.0", size: 15.2, status: "live" },
    { id: 6, app: "raylb", version: "0.2.4", size: 4.8, status: "draft" },
  ];
  t.addEventListener("ray-row-click", (e) => { out.textContent = `Opened ${e.detail.row.app}`; });
  t.addEventListener("ray-selection-change", (e) => { out.textContent = `${e.detail.selection.length} selected`; });
  const empty = document.getElementById("demo-table-empty");
  empty.columns = [{ key: "app", label: "App" }, { key: "when", label: "When" }];
  empty.data = [];
</script>

Notification

Toasts: notify(), updateNotification(), hideNotification(), clearNotifications(); shown in a ray-toaster (a polite live region in the top layer). ray-notification is usable on its own.

Notify With an action Loading → done Error
ray-remote 0.4.1 is ready to publish. type error at 12:5: 'f' expects 2 argument(s) update.json is signed with a key that expires in 7 days. ray 0.9 is available. bundle-macos-arm64.zip Sunday, December 3 at 9:00 AM

Several toasts stack; hover (or tap, on touch screens) to spread them. Swipe one sideways to dismiss it.

HTML
<div class="demo-row">
  <ray-button id="demo-notify" variant="default">Notify</ray-button>
  <ray-button id="demo-notify-undo" variant="default">With an action</ray-button>
  <ray-button id="demo-notify-load" variant="default">Loading → done</ray-button>
  <ray-button id="demo-notify-error" variant="light" color="red">Error</ray-button>
</div>
<div style="display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; max-width: 24rem">
  <ray-notification label="Build finished" color="green" with-border>ray-remote 0.4.1 is ready to publish.</ray-notification>
  <ray-notification label="Build failed" color="red" with-border>type error at 12:5: 'f' expects 2 argument(s)</ray-notification>
  <ray-notification label="Certificate expires soon" color="yellow" with-border>update.json is signed with a key that expires in 7 days.</ray-notification>
  <ray-notification label="New version" color="blue" with-border>ray 0.9 is available.</ray-notification>
  <ray-notification label="Uploading" loading hide-close with-border>bundle-macos-arm64.zip</ray-notification>
  <ray-notification label="Event created" action-label="Undo" with-border>Sunday, December 3 at 9:00 AM</ray-notification>
</div>
<p style="margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: var(--ray-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--ray-font-size-sm)">Several toasts stack; hover (or tap, on touch screens) to spread them. Swipe one sideways to dismiss it.</p>
<script type="module">
  import { notify, updateNotification } from "../src/components/notification/notification.js";
  document.getElementById("demo-notify").addEventListener("click", () =>
    notify({ title: "Saved", message: "Your changes are on disk." }));
  document.getElementById("demo-notify-undo").addEventListener("click", () =>
    notify({ title: "Event created", message: "Sunday, December 3 at 9:00 AM", action: { label: "Undo", onClick: () => notify({ message: "Event removed." }) } }));
  document.getElementById("demo-notify-load").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const id = notify({ title: "Deploying", message: "Uploading the bundle…", loading: true, closable: false });
    setTimeout(() => updateNotification(id, { title: "Deployed", message: "ray-remote 0.4.1 is live.", loading: false, color: "green", closable: true }), 1500);
  });
  document.getElementById("demo-notify-error").addEventListener("click", () =>
    notify({ title: "Build failed", message: "type error at 12:5: 'f' expects 2 argument(s)", color: "red", autoClose: false }));
</script>

<ray-toaster>

Created by notify() when missing; add one yourself to choose its position. A stack (newest in front, older ones peeking behind) that spreads into a list on hover or keyboard focus; on touch screens a tap expands it, a tap outside collapses it, and a sideways swipe dismisses a toast. Auto-close pauses while expanded. Full width on phones.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription

expandexpand reflectsbooleanAlways expanded: a list instead of a stack.
gapgapnumber12Pixels between toasts when expanded.
